end.summary:
Pihu named earthworms and ants as animals seen in soil or near plants.
They suggested rainwater may bring earthworms upward to breathe.
They were unsure whether the animal under a tree was an earthworm or beetle.
They said earthworms may spoil soil; this was not corrected before the lesson ended.
Teach-back was not passed; Pihu stopped because they were tired.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying soil animals and discussing why earthworms may appear near the surface. Pihu used observations from the garden and described ants moving in a line. They mixed up the role of earthworms by saying they spoil soil, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, look at a small patch of soil together and ask Pihu to name what they see and share one way each animal may affect the soil.
